concept: Transfer Family: managed SFTP for partners into S3
tests: Choosing a managed SFTP endpoint for partners to upload files directly into S3.
expected: AWS Transfer Family — managed SFTP/FTPS/FTP/AS2 with delivery to S3 or EFS. Triggers: "external partners", "standard SFTP", "files land in S3", "no SFTP servers or patching".
why_not: DataSync is agent-based bulk sync, not partner SFTP; Firehose ingests streaming records; Snowcone is an offline device.
